limitations: Pilot only: no mode1 results reviewed here and no statistical performance claims.

Runner reports final matches/proposals, not each refined proposal before NMS, trial histories or NCC at truth; exact rejection/convergence cause may remain unresolved.

findings.finding: Both modes have strict TP7/FP5/FN5 but localization TP12/FP0/FN0. The five failures at truth indices1,3,6,9,11 violate scale only; maximum position error across all12 is0.037451px, angle0.145167degree. They are not180degree errors or missing locations.

All12 estimated scales are lower than generation truth, by1.4509%-2.7467%. Five fail the unchanged2%scale gate despite finalNCC0.97467-0.98381. All12 have a proposal whose configured solver box contains truth. High finalNCC does not certify geometric-scale accuracy.

Small-template interpolation/sampling bias is a plausible next hypothesis: the17x33 template is affine-bilinear rendered then bilinear sampled during refinement; the larger140x102 clean case has much smaller0.1183%-0.1990% downward-scale bias. Different templates/poses confound this comparison. Existing records do not include objective values at GT or trajectories, so they cannot prove aliasing, biased optimum or failed convergence.

Both modes have strict TP4/FP3/FN8, localization TP7/FP0/FN5. Accepted outputs at truths1 and2 are177.7603degree and179.1799degree wrong, scores0.82628/0.80821, position13.1295/13.2319px; neither truth has a correct-orientation proposal inside configured solver bounds. These are near-opposite pose failures, not evidence that object symmetry makes them correct.

Truth0 has geometric proposal coverage but final error3.4709px/2.9076degree/4.0175%scale atNCC0.91431. Missing-localization truths3,5,6 also lack a valid solver-box proposal; missing truths7,11 retain valid proposals but have no accepted output within20px. Raw JSON cannot distinguish low final score, local solve or NMS rejection for those latter two.

Clean new_texture12 uses the same geometry and passes12/12. Degraded12 adds0/10/25/40%local strip occlusion, sigma1blur andnoise8 together; cannot isolate one cause. It is an additional condition on12 existing poses, not12 more independent scenes. Keep challenge errors and normal small-template failures visible.

Before changing thresholds: independently evaluate NCC at GT versus accepted pose and perturbations for failed small templates, then run a predeclared renderer/sampling ablation and a solver trajectory diagnostic. Separately preserve alternate-orientation proposals or test robust/masked scoring for degraded inputs. These are follow-up studies, not executed fixes or conclusions from this audit.

subsequent_bounded_cpu_objective_probe.interpretation: With truth x/y/angle fixed, all12 objective slices peak below true scale and above the true-scale NCC. This supports a sampling/objective bias in the saved small-template input rather than attributing the five failures solely to solver convergence; renderer, double resampling, blur, template shape and other causes remain unisolated.
